definition.name: NXoperando_tofnpd

symbols.doc: Symbols used in dimension declarations. Each symbol binds within a single group instance: nE may differ between electrochemistry series. Bank pattern lengths vary per bank and are therefore not constrained by a symbol.

symbol.name: nE
symbol.doc: Number of points in one electrochemistry time series.

symbol.name: nBank
symbol.doc: Number of detector banks described in the instrument-level detector geometry arrays.

definition.doc: Application definition for operando powder diffraction of electrochemical cells at a time-of-flight neutron source. A single entry holds the experiment-level instrument and sample description together with the full electrochemical cycling record; each diffraction acquisition is a sequentially numbered NXsubentry (scan_000001, scan_000002, ...) modelled on NXtofnpd, carrying the electrochemical state of the cell during that acquisition.

attribute.name: default
attribute.doc: Name of the NXdata group to visualise first, typically operando_electrochemistry.

field.name: definition
field.doc: Official NeXus NXDL schema to which this file conforms.

field.name: program_name
field.doc: Name of the program that generated this file (provenance).

field.name: pre_sample_flightpath
field.doc: Primary (moderator-to-sample) flight path of the instrument, as in NXtofnpd. Required in the published Figure 4; optional here because it is not recorded in reduced data files and is supplied from OperaXN's per-instrument profile, whose value may be unset. Written only when the profile provides a value.

group.name: process
group.doc: Provenance of the diffraction–electrochemistry correlation: the generating program and the parameters used to match each diffraction acquisition to the electrochemical record.

field.name: data_source
field.doc: Origin of the diffraction data.

field.name: correlation_method
field.doc: absolute: diffraction and electrochemistry clocks are synchronised and matched on absolute timestamps. relative: streams are aligned on elapsed time from their respective starts (unsynchronised clocks).

field.name: echem_time_tolerance
field.doc: Maximum accepted distance between a scan timestamp and its matched electrochemistry point.

attribute.name: target
attribute.doc: HDF5 path of this group; marks it as the original that the per-scan instrument soft links point to.

group.name: detector
group.doc: Per-bank detector geometry, one element per focussed bank, mirroring the NXtofnpd detector arrays. The values are not recorded in reduced data files; OperaXN supplies them from its per-instrument profile and writes an array only when every bank provides that quantity.

field.name: detector_number
field.doc: Bank numbers, in the order used by the geometry arrays below (present whenever any of them is).

field.name: distance
field.doc: Secondary (sample-to-detector) flight path of each bank.

field.name: polar_angle
field.doc: Nominal scattering angle (two-theta) of each bank.

field.name: azimuthal_angle
field.doc: Nominal azimuthal angle of each bank.

field.name: description
field.doc: Cell chemistry, electrode composition, cell format and fabrication details. Required in the published Figure 4; recommended here because it is human-entered and cannot be harvested from the source data. Tightening to required is deferred to the NIAC submission.

field.name: preparation_date
field.doc: Date the electrochemical cell was assembled (human-entered at upload; stored as a timezone-aware ISO 8601 timestamp).

group.name: cycling_protocol
group.doc: Human-entered description of the electrochemical cycling protocol applied during the operando experiment. Required in the published Figure 4; recommended here because none of it can be harvested from the diffraction or electrochemistry source files. Tightening to required is deferred to the NIAC submission. When the group is present, technique is required.

field.name: technique
field.doc: Electrochemical technique applied (e.g. galvanostatic cycling, GITT, CV), including any ageing protocol the cell was subjected to before the operando experiment.

field.name: voltage_window_lower
field.doc: Lower cut-off voltage of the cycling window.

field.name: voltage_window_upper
field.doc: Upper cut-off voltage of the cycling window.

field.name: C_rate
field.doc: Nominal C-rate of the cycling, as a free-text label (e.g. C/10, 1C).

field.name: instrument
field.doc: Potentiostat/galvanostat make and model used for the cycling.

field.name: software
field.doc: Control/acquisition software of the potentiostat, with version.

field.name: raw_data_file
field.doc: Name or DOI of the raw electrochemistry data file this record was taken from.

group.name: operando_electrochemistry
group.doc: Full electrochemical cycling record of the operando experiment. Time is stored as elapsed seconds with the absolute origin in the start attribute (NXlog convention), enabling both plotting and re-correlation against the scan subentries. Required in the published Figure 4; recommended here because it is absent from diffraction-only files (no electrochemistry supplied) and present whenever an electrochemistry record was correlated.

group.name: standard_electrochemistry
group.doc: Additional electrochemistry files associated with the experiment but not time-correlated with the diffraction data (e.g. formation cycles), one NXdata group per source file.
One source file, named file_NNN (file_001, file_002, ...).

group.name: SCAN
group.doc: One group per diffraction acquisition, named scan_NNNNNN with a zero-padded sequence number (scan_000001, scan_000002, ...). The measurement setup is invariant during the experiment: by convention each subentry carries an HDF5 soft link named "instrument" (with a target attribute) to the experiment-level /entry/instrument group rather than a copy. This is documented here rather than declared as an NXDL link: links cannot be optional in the NXDL schema, and pynxtools traverses the soft link and checks its target attribute but does not match a declared link against a linked group, so declaring it would fail every conforming file. Linking avoids N copies of the invariant instrument description.

field.name: definition
field.doc: Ratified technique definition this subentry is modelled on. Deviations from NXtofnpd (NX_NUMBER data, per-bank NXdata groups) are documented at the top of this definition; NXoperando_tofnpd is the authoritative schema for the subentry contents.

field.name: end_time
field.doc: Required in practice: neutron acquisitions are long and the window bounds the electrochemistry summary.

group.name: environment
group.doc: Electrochemical state of the cell during this acquisition.

field.name: voltage
field.doc: Cell voltage at the electrochemistry point nearest the midpoint of the acquisition window. Required in the published Figure 4; recommended here because it is present only when the acquisition was correlated with an electrochemistry point within process/echem_time_tolerance (absent for uncorrelated scans and for diffraction-only files).

field.name: current
field.doc: Cell current at the matched electrochemistry point. Same presence rule as voltage: written only when the scan was correlated within process/echem_time_tolerance.

field.name: voltage_min
field.doc: Minimum cell voltage over the acquisition window [start_time, end_time]. Required in the published Figure 4; optional here because it needs at least one electrochemistry sample inside the window (short acquisitions against a sparse logging cadence have none).

field.name: voltage_max
field.doc: Maximum cell voltage over the acquisition window; same presence rule as voltage_min.

field.name: current_min
field.doc: Minimum cell current over the acquisition window; same presence rule as voltage_min.

field.name: current_max
field.doc: Maximum cell current over the acquisition window; same presence rule as voltage_min.

field.name: capacity
field.doc: Charge passed up to this acquisition (e.g. mAh). Reserved per the published specification; not yet populated by OperaXN.

field.name: scan_timestamp
field.doc: Midpoint of the acquisition window, used for correlation.

field.name: voltage_timestamp
field.doc: Timestamp of the matched electrochemistry point.

field.name: echem_index_first
field.doc: First index (0-based) of the acquisition window within the operando_electrochemistry arrays. The published Figure 4 prints this pair as echem_index_start/_end; _first/_last is used here because _end is a reserved NeXus field-name suffix.

field.name: echem_index_last
field.doc: Last index (0-based, inclusive) of the acquisition window within the operando_electrochemistry arrays (printed as echem_index_end in Figure 4; see echem_index_first).

group.name: voltage_log
group.doc: Voltage segment spanning the acquisition window; recommended for long neutron acquisitions.

One focussed pattern per detector bank. Groups holding the native time-of-flight pattern are named bank_N and carry the time_of_flight axis; the optional d-spacing pattern of the same bank is a sibling group named bank_N_d carrying the d_spacing axis. Exactly one of time_of_flight or d_spacing must be present in each group (not expressible in NXDL for variable-name groups).

attribute.name: spectrum
attribute.doc: Spectrum/workspace index in the source reduction file.

attribute.name: y_unit
attribute.doc: Intensity unit label as exported by the reduction software.

attribute.name: x_label
attribute.doc: Verbatim axis label from the source file (e.g. Mantid "Time-of-flight").

field.name: data
field.doc: Focussed intensities. Relaxed from NXtofnpd's NX_INT to NX_NUMBER: these are processed, not raw counts.
